finding: M4.1 had generalized the planner and native instrument to consume contract_multiplier, but observation, pending-order, hard-risk current-exposure, and executed-exposure calculations still valued raw quantity times mark. Contracts with multiplier != 1 therefore understated notional exposure; position_quantity was also reported in a unit inconsistent with the BTC unit label.
change: HistoricalEnvironmentFactory now computes all position notionals from raw native quantity × mark × the frozen contract multiplier. Pending signed/gross exposure and the executed policy exposure use that unit conversion, and position_quantity reports effective base units. The planner still receives raw native contract quantity.
